summary: This visual presents a comprehensive analysis of payroll and losses over a span of years from 1998 to 2007. The top section illustrates payroll figures in millions of dollars, showing a steady increase from approximately $1.5 million in 1998 to around $2 million in 2007. The middle section depicts losses in thousands of dollars, peaking at nearly $35,000 in 1999, followed by a significant decline in subsequent years, reaching minimal losses by 2007. The bottom section details losses per $1,000 of payroll, which started at $18.20 in 1998 and decreased dramatically to $0.30 by 2007, indicating a substantial improvement in loss management relative to payroll. Overall, the data reveals a positive trend in payroll growth alongside a significant reduction in losses over the analyzed period.
